physicalNotes: Radius 1.31 +/- 0.03 solar radii from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract): 911,367 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.05 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6005 +/- 50 K from Šubjak et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2458 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...693A.235S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
